cases.authorIntent: Five weeks executed, a kept two-week holiday, a race week with the race touch done at half its minutes, then a separate four-day trip (run-only plan)

independentAssessment.rationale: a half-length race touch is no race touch done as prescribed: the race week re-enters nothing and the stop runs from the holiday
independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: a half-length race touch is no race touch done as prescribed: the race week re-enters nothing and the stop runs from the holiday

cases.authorIntent: Four separate breaks with a run-complete week between each pair (a two-level chain of own returns)

independentAssessment.rationale: each break is its own return in turn; the trip by its own days; running resumes what it executed
independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: each break is its own return in turn; the trip by its own days; running resumes what it executed

cases.authorIntent: Five weeks executed, a kept two-week holiday, a race week without a gated run whose strength session and optional shakeout carry an adverse recovery, then a separate four-day trip

independentAssessment.rationale: converging adverse responses across sports hold the race week: no sport re-enters by it and the stop runs from the holiday
independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: converging adverse responses across sports hold the race week: no sport re-enters by it and the stop runs from the holiday

cases.authorIntent: A kept holiday, two weeks short of complete, a trip applied, then corrected by name so that the Sunday long run before it, never reported, lies between the breaks; then that run reported done

independentAssessment.rationale: the correction uncovers the Sunday long run: it is asked first; answered done, the running week counts and the holiday is its own return
independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: the correction uncovers the Sunday long run: it is asked first; answered done, the running week counts and the holiday is its own return

cases.authorIntent: Four separate breaks, the first overlapping the second, with a run-complete week between the others (a two-level chain of own returns)

independentAssessment.rationale: each break is its own return in turn, the first two read as one stop; the trip by its own days
independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: each break is its own return in turn, the first two read as one stop; the trip by its own days

cases.authorIntent: A return read from separate breaks, a late lift on the earlier break's first day, then that break restated with a start time before the lift

independentAssessment.rationale: the lift falls inside the holiday, as the return read it: nothing changes
independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: the lift falls inside the holiday, as the return read it: nothing changes

cases.authorIntent: A return read from separate breaks, a late lift on the earlier break's first day, then that break restated with a start time after the lift and the trip confirmed

independentAssessment.preferredCoachingBehavior: the lift counts before the holiday: the coach asks to confirm the trip, and the confirmation re-reads the return
